observations: Offline session.cpp splits the text first, then prepares text embeddings, builds the acoustic cache, decodes and appends audio once per tokenizer chunk. Equal UTF-8 byte length or characters alone do not establish equal chunk counts or capacities.
max_frames=0 uses ceil((tokens/3 + 2) * model frame rate) per chunk. Voice preparation, text and EOS behavior can change generated frames. The three default cases retain distinct resource keys.

An explicit positive max_frames fixes the acoustic cap per chunk. With frames_after_eos set equal to max_frames the EOS break cannot occur before the fixed cap, irrespective of seed. The fixed sentence, tokenizer, voice waveform and all other controls must still match.

The acoustic RNG is seeded in begin_stream and changes latent values; noise_clamp=-1 uses ordinary fixed-size normal sampling. The acoustic graph and cache capacities depend on prompt/voice shape and max steps. The waveform still changes with seed.

For these exact weights the mono decoder produces 1920 PCM samples per acoustic step. The proposed one-chunk 32-step seed sweep therefore checks 61440 samples, PCM16 mono 24 kHz, 122924 WAV bytes and three independently generated fingerprints.

budgetPolicy: For each effective key aggregate every measured run, including earlier defaults. Add the controller peak to max(kernel process-tree committed peak, sum of lifetime peak working sets), add 25% and round up to 64 MiB. Double measured temporary output and round up to MiB for both output and copy; separately double total measured publication directory and round up to MiB. Double the largest recorded host or native elapsed time, round up to 10 seconds with a 30 second floor.

boundedEnglishText.status: Four calibration inputs and an independently held-out utterance with a held-out seed completed normal resource admission, generated and published output, reopened state and rejected out-of-domain text.
boundedEnglishText.scope: Pinned English GGUF, explicit specification, CPU engine with four threads, fixed reference voice, maxFrames=framesAfterEos=32 and textChunkTokens=50. One already-normalized ASCII sentence beginning with uppercase letter, words of English letters separated by a single space and ending in one period, up to 31 characters inclusive. All other settings remain bound to the effective workload.
boundedEnglishText.rationale: The built-in English text conditioner leaves this grammar unchanged. Its embedded 4000-piece unigram SentencePiece model uses identity normalization, a single leading word marker and one marker per space; every accepted letter, period and marker has a normal inventory piece. With no unknown expansion or added BOS/EOS, at most 32 normalized scalars yield at most 32 tokens in one chunk. The CPU tiered graph floors prompt capacity at 32, gathering up to 32 embeddings. A fixed 32-step generation cap and 32-step EOS tail force the same number of generated frames in each one-chunk run. The review keeps the measured 32-token endpoint and smaller prompts. Resource admission does not guarantee intelligibility of arbitrary strings.
boundedEnglishText.qualityObservation: The independent Qwen3 ASR reproduced all three ordinary short sentences, including the held-out sentence. It transcribed the one-letter utterance I. as I. I.; the artificial 32-token upper-bound string was tested solely for resource shape.
